title: Positive square-energy strengthening
statement: Every connected n-vertex graph with at least n+1 edges has s⁺(G)≥n, where s⁺ is the sum of squares of the positive adjacency eigenvalues.

counterexample.description: A connected simple graph on 10–14 vertices with at least n+1 edges whose exactly bounded positive adjacency square energy is strictly less than n. This is the stronger n-bound, not the now-proved older n−1 statement.
